manualReview.scope: Model/editor rewrite review for Lessons 0014–0020 after activity-variety, load, naturalness and skill-mix revisions; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: What day?, On Monday. and Monday. are natural short forms when the library program is already the topic.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked learner-facing Persian for meaning, clarity and current Nova orthography rules; wording stays colloquial and context-specific.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Only Monday is introduced in the first day Lesson; Tuesday is deferred to prevent an unnecessary load spike.

distractorQuality.evidence: The reading and controlled phrase tasks distinguish day, time and room information.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Leo and Liam schedule the next library event in a short, context-supported exchange.

difficultyFit.evidence: Three new items replace the previous four-item/two-day load.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Monday is read, heard, selected and produced without adding a second weekday.

transferQuality.evidence: The question-answer pattern transfers directly from clock time to day while the semantic category changes.

overallCoherence.evidence: The tasks consistently support understanding and stating one program day.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review only. Activity order is more varied and help/feedback paths are present, but no real learner, microphone, timing or retention test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio still requires perceptual/prosody review with human listeners.
Hidden-answer retrieval remains bounded and cannot certify open-ended language ability.
